name: No building/structure over or across sewer
handbook: Code of Practice on Sewerage and Sanitary Works
sourceFile: Capability Testing Pack/Annex A - The rules/SSW 1.2.4 (a)(i) No building structure over or across sewer.docx
description: No structure or building shall be placed over or across any sewer without the approval of PUB.

interpretation.verdictLogic: NON_COMPLIANT if any building/structure geometry intersects the sewer pipe or comes within the required setback distance. COMPLIANT if the building is placed away from the sewer with the required setback maintained.
interpretation.geometryNote: The one rule in this pack that is purely geometric rather than a label/value lookup -- it compares the sewer pipe's centerline against the building footprint polygon (a spatial intersection or minimum-distance test), not a text annotation to read.

sampleScenarios.description: A building is located with required sewer setback distance from the sewer.
A building is placed over a sewer.

matchedPlanElement.note: The plan draws a '1M SEWER SETBACK LINE' next to the existing sewer, so the required setback distance (1m) is known, and the building footprint visually appears to stay outside it. Real DXF files now exist for both sample drawings (via ODA File Converter, see docs/design-decisions.md) and do contain the LWPOLYLINE geometry this rule would need -- but extracting the *specific* sewer-centerline and building-footprint polylines (as opposed to reading text, which is all src/extraction/dxf-search.ts does) has not been implemented. Resolves to NEEDS_REVIEW: a visual impression on a screenshot is not a computed distance, and this project does not report a verdict it cannot actually compute. The rule engine itself (src/rules/ssw-1-2-4-a-no-structure-over-sewer.ts, src/geometry/distance.ts) is fully implemented and unit-tested against synthetic coordinates -- of the whole pipeline, only the geometry-extraction step remains, and it's now a scoping/time question, not a tooling blocker.
